suites.title: CL-3 Edit and delete a contact

specs.title: SCN-001: The edit form is pre-filled with the contact's current values

steps.title: Given I am signed in and have a contact with every field filled
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
And I opened that contact's Contact Details page from the Contact List
[SEED] sign in as qa-lmjpd27q-1@example.com
When I press "Edit Contact"
Then the Edit Contact page shows every field with the contact's current value

specs.title: SCN-002: Editing the city saves it and shows it on the Contact Details page

steps.title: Given I am signed in and have a contact in Anytown
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
And I am on that contact's Edit Contact page
[SEED] sign in as qa-lmjpatj2-1@example.com
When I change the city to a new value and press Submit
Then I am on the Contact Details page
And it shows the new city

specs.title: SCN-003: An edit in the web app is what the API returns

steps.title: Given I am signed in and have a contact in Anytown
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
And I am on that contact's Edit Contact page
[SEED] sign in as qa-lmjpattm-1@example.com
When I change the city to a new value and press Submit
Then GET /contacts/{id} returns 200 with the new city

specs.title: SCN-004: Emptying the phone in the web app clears it

steps.title: Given I am signed in and have a contact with a phone number
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
And I am on that contact's Edit Contact page
[SEED] sign in as qa-lmjpclbs-1@example.com
When I empty the phone and press Submit
Then the Contact Details page shows no phone
And GET /contacts/{id} returns null for the phone

specs.title: SCN-005: An invalid e-mail is refused and nothing is stored

steps.title: Given I am signed in and have a contact
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
And I am on that contact's Edit Contact page
[SEED] sign in as qa-lmjs0kmz-2@example.com
When I enter the e-mail "not-an-email" and press Submit
Then I stay on the Edit Contact page
And a message containing "Email is invalid" is shown
And GET /contacts/{id} returns the contact unchanged

specs.title: SCN-006: PUT replaces the contact

steps.title: Given I have a contact with every field filled
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
When I PUT a complete contact with new values to /contacts/{id}
Then the answer is 200 with the full updated contact

specs.title: SCN-007: PUT clears the optional fields it does not send

steps.title: Given I have a contact with every field filled
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
When I PUT only a first and a last name to /contacts/{id}
Then the answer is 200 and every optional field is null

specs.title: SCN-008: PATCH changes only the fields it sends

steps.title: Given I have a contact with every field filled
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
When I PATCH a new city to /contacts/{id}
Then the answer is 200 with the new city
And every other field keeps its previous value

specs.title: SCN-009.1: An update that would lose the first or last name is refused (PUT without firstName)

steps.title: Given I have a contact with every field filled
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
When I send PUT without firstName
Then the answer is 400 with a JSON message
And the stored contact is exactly as it was

specs.title: SCN-009.2: An update that would lose the first or last name is refused (PUT without lastName)

steps.title: Given I have a contact with every field filled
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
When I send PUT without lastName
Then the answer is 400 with a JSON message
And the stored contact is exactly as it was

specs.title: SCN-009.3: An update that would lose the first or last name is refused (PUT with firstName "")

steps.title: Given I have a contact with every field filled
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
When I send PUT with firstName ""
Then the answer is 400 with a JSON message
And the stored contact is exactly as it was

specs.title: SCN-009.4: An update that would lose the first or last name is refused (PATCH with lastName "")

steps.title: Given I have a contact with every field filled
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
When I send PATCH with lastName ""
Then the answer is 400 with a JSON message
And the stored contact is exactly as it was

specs.title: SCN-010: Cancelling the delete keeps the contact

steps.title: Given I am signed in and on a contact's Contact Details page
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
[SEED] sign in as qa-lmjtxntx-4@example.com
When I press "Delete Contact" and cancel "Are you sure you want to delete this contact?"
Then I stay on the Contact Details page
And the contact still exists

specs.title: SCN-011: Confirming the delete removes the contact

steps.title: Given I am signed in and on a contact's Contact Details page
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
[SEED] sign in as qa-lmju4xfb-4@example.com
When I press "Delete Contact" and confirm "Are you sure you want to delete this contact?"
Then I am on the Contact List page
And the contact is no longer listed

specs.title: SCN-012: DELETE answers "Contact deleted"

steps.title: Given I have a contact
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
When I send DELETE /contacts/{id}
Then the answer is 200 with the body "Contact deleted"

specs.title: SCN-013: A deleted contact is gone for good

steps.title: Given I had a contact and deleted it with DELETE /contacts/{id}
[SEED] account
[SEED] contact
Then GET /contacts/{id} answers 404 with an empty body
And GET /contacts does not list it
And a second DELETE, a PUT and a PATCH on it answer 404 with an empty body

specs.title: SCN-014.1: A malformed contact id is refused (GET)

steps.title: When I send GET /contacts/abc
[SEED] account
Then the answer is 400 with the body "Invalid Contact ID"

specs.title: SCN-014.2: A malformed contact id is refused (PUT)

steps.title: When I send PUT /contacts/abc
[SEED] account
Then the answer is 400 with the body "Invalid Contact ID"

specs.title: SCN-014.3: A malformed contact id is refused (PATCH)

steps.title: When I send PATCH /contacts/abc
[SEED] account
Then the answer is 400 with the body "Invalid Contact ID"

specs.title: SCN-014.4: A malformed contact id is refused (DELETE)

steps.title: When I send DELETE /contacts/abc
[SEED] account
Then the answer is 400 with the body "Invalid Contact ID"
